source: The noise served a training purpose in the original design, including support for load balancing and exploration. It should not be generalized into “all ZXNAME0000XZ routers add noise.” Many later routers use different mechanisms.
zh: 噪声在原始设计中用于训练目的，包括支持负载平衡和探索。不应将其概括为“所有 ZXNAME0000XZ 路由器都会增加噪音”。许多后来的路由器使用不同的机制。
